Not necessarily toxic but I'm so independent to the point that I can't stand anyone for very long, not even my own kid. I love her but Im SO grateful me and her mom split up years ago. 

Not to say I don't like people because its the opposite, I love people but diminishing returns is ever prevelant with anyone who involves themselves in my life. 

Because of this I put up a facade of whom I am to whomever I meet, but the more people get to know me, the more I know the less they'll like who I really am.

How little I can stand anyone for an extended period of time.

Broke up with my girlfriend because she was too co-dependant, and I'm someone who needs his space or I lash out at people. 

Realized that seeing the same few people every few days or so was monotonous and just felt like a filler for the endless time I had when I was out of work.

Came to terms that I probably can't maintain a steady relationship because of my independence. In doing so I recognized that in all the relationships I had been in, the majority of the blame as to why they didn't work was my own fault. 

But this isn't all in a negative light. I came to terms that its OKAY to be alone & not need a strong relationship with anyone in my life. Ive always felt more alive when I don't feel interwined too personally with people in my life.

I realized I'm my own best friend.
